items.statement: The submitted calculation preserves neutral singlet 1bb and the implicit DCM boundary and documents the chosen computational model.
items.expected: The report identifies the supplied SMILES, charge 0, multiplicity 1, DCM, software and method choices.

items.statement: The selected lowest transition is supported by convergence and an independent validation check tied to the submitted structure/state.
items.expected: A reproducible state-selection rule and at least one concrete independent check are reported; bounded failure is documented honestly if convergence fails.

items.statement: The source-reported lowest-energy transition of 1bb in DCM has excitation energy 4.3134 eV.
The source-reported lowest-energy transition of 1bb in DCM has wavelength 287.44 nm.
The source-reported oscillator strength is 0.3412 and Table4 D-column value is 3.2290 (numerically |mu|^2 in atomic units, not Debye).
items.expected: f = 0.3412 and Table4 D-column value = 3.2290; compare a Debye magnitude only after sqrt(D)*2.541746 conversion.

items.statement: The lowest transition is predominantly π→π* in the NTO interpretation.
items.expected: The report assigns predominantly π→π* character and explains the orbital evidence.
